items.label: 1857年
items.title: 社会学先驱孔德在巴黎辞世
items.text: 法国哲学家孔德在巴黎寓所去世。他创立实证主义哲学，主张用可观察事实与科学方法研究社会，在《实证哲学教程》中系统构想这门新学问，为后来社会学的发展铺设了道路。

sources.date_quote: Comte died on September 5, 1857, without having had time to draft the texts announced up to 35 years before
sources.fact_quote: Auguste Comte (1798–1857) is the founder of positivism, a philosophical and political movement which enjoyed a very wide diffusion in the second half of the nineteenth century.

items.label: 1906年
items.title: 统计物理奠基人玻尔兹曼去世
items.text: 奥地利物理学家玻尔兹曼在杜伊诺去世。他把热力学第二定律还原为分子微观运动的统计结果，给出了熵与微观状态数相联系的著名公式，是统计力学和原子理论的重要奠基者。

sources.date_quote: The plaque is to hang in the hotel—now a college—where Boltzmann committed suicide on 5 September 1906 while on vacation with his family.
sources.fact_quote: the Austrian physicist and mathematician Ludwig Boltzmann is being honored with a commemorative plaque in Duino, Italy.

sources.date_quote: Died: 5 September 1906, Duino (near Trieste), Austria (now Italy)
sources.fact_quote: Ludwig Boltzmann was an Austrian mathematician who made important advances in electromagnetism and thermodynamics.

items.label: 1939年
items.title: 免疫学家利根川进出生
items.text: 利根川进生于日本名古屋。他用实验阐明，种类繁多的抗体来自B淋巴细胞发育过程中基因片段的重排组合，从而解开免疫系统应对海量抗原的难题，并于1987年获得诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。

sources.fact_quote: In 1976 Susumu Tonegawa showed how this is possible through the redistribution of genes in a cell during its development into an antibody-producing B lymphocyte.

items.label: 1984年
items.title: 发现号航天飞机完成处女航
items.text: 发现号航天飞机完成代号STS-41-D的处女航，降落在加州爱德华兹空军基地。约六天的行程中，机组部署了三颗商业通信卫星，还展开实验性的大型太阳能帆板，为航天供电技术积累经验。

sources.fact_quote: Three satellites deployed during this mission: Satellite Business System SBS-D, SYNCOM IV-2 (also known as LEASAT2) and TELSTAR.

items.label: 2002年
items.title: 宇宙微波背景研究专家威尔金森去世
items.text: 美国宇宙学家大卫·威尔金森在普林斯顿去世。他从1960年代起持续投身宇宙微波背景辐射的测量，从地面实验、气球到太空卫星不断推进精度，美国宇航局后来将一颗探测卫星以他的名字命名。

sources.date_quote: After a long struggle with cancer, David Wilkinson died on September 5, 2002. He was 67.
sources.fact_quote: NASA renamed an orbiting satellite, called the Microwave Anisotropy Probe, in honor of David T. Wilkinson

items.label: 2017年
items.title: 激光光谱学先驱布隆伯根去世
items.text: 荷兰裔美籍物理学家布隆伯根在亚利桑那州图森去世。上世纪60年代，他用多束激光精确测定原子与分子的能级，发展出非线性激光光谱方法，并因此与肖洛分享了1981年诺贝尔物理学奖。

sources.fact_quote: In the 1960s Nicolaas Bloembergen used laser light, which has waves in phase and of the same wavelength, to determine energy levels with great precision.
